req_desc: The product is one personal portfolio read on a single continuous scroll ...
An unpublished piece stays closed until the owning author publishes ...
The only state a visitor creates is a note, a subscription, a page-view tally
A signed-out visitor reads any published piece ...
Signup is open to anyone from the sign-up route
Every seeded account signs in with the password `deku-demo-pw-2026` ...
A successful sign in returns a bearer token ...
A second signup on a taken email is rejected as invalid ...
An invalid form submission names the field that is wrong ...
The bands endpoint returns a top-level JSON array of nine entries ...
The left rail names the band the reader is currently in ...
The experience band carries six roles across four employers ...
The first screen carries a turning triangulated wireframe volume ...
The field is drawn as a single drawing call ...
The field render loop stops once the field is fully covered ...
The field falls back to a still frame under a reduced-motion preference ...
A diagram is declared as a structure of nodes, edges, annotations, a timeline, a layout
A node kind is one of `box`, `gate`, `store`, `terminal` ...
The same structure renders the same drawing on two consecutive renders ...
One structure renders the tall layout plus the wide layout with no second input ...
A system diagram carries a run log of exactly four rows ...
Every diagram carries a text alternative describing its nodes in order ...
An author composes a piece in a three-step wizard ...
Creating a piece stores the piece with the draft status ...
A diagram still is written under the key scheme `diagrams/{diagram_id}/{sha256_of_bytes}.{ext}` ...
An export is refused when validation reports a finding ...
A draft piece answers only the owning author's session ...
Publishing moves the piece to the published status with a publication timestamp ...
A repeated publish leaves exactly one published piece ...
The fixed contact control opens a panel over the page rather than navigating ...
A note name shorter than `2` characters is rejected as invalid ...
Creating a note returns a thread token ...
A sender adds a message to their own thread ...
Subscribing records the address in the pending state ...
A fourth note from one address inside an hour is refused ...
A note's sorting total is computed once at creation from six signals ...
A note whose total reaches `4` lands in the `signal` lane ...
A note arriving when sorting cannot run is stored with no lane
The desk shows three lanes ...
A note in the best lane is offered three slots from the next two weeks ...
A first-time visitor is asked once about non-essential cookies ...
A page view is recorded with its route, the day, the deepest band reached ...
Every internal link on every public route resolves
An unknown address renders the code `404` ...
A privacy page is reachable from the footer of every route ...
The index route is public ...
A signed-out request for a protected route lands on the sign-in route ...
Every list carries an empty state naming the absence in one sentence ...
The page reads as an evenly stepped neutral ramp ...
Prose sits in one family with every label, figure, timestamp, annotation in a mono family ...
Bands separate by space rather than by a dividing line ...
One house ease governs every hover, entrance, scrubbed reveal ...
A reduced-motion preference holds the field on its first frame ...
Body text meets WCAG AA contrast against the page ground ...
Nothing overflows sideways at a narrow viewport ...
Each route leads with one primary action distinct from every secondary one
Every control carries a resting, pointed-at, pressed, focused, unavailable state
Each route is rendered on the server as a complete document ...
The first response carries every diagram's final geometry as markup
No host, port, credential is hardcoded anywhere in the app
No second datastore, cache, queue, object store, mail vendor is introduced
No message of any kind leaves the application ...
No credential appears in anything the browser downloads ...
The site serves a favicon declared in the document head
The archive route creates no drawing context ...
The counter climbs continuously from the elapsed time on the page ...
The datastore carries sixteen tables ...
An account row carries an email stored lowercase, a password hash, a display name, a role ...
A career role row carries an employer, a city, a title, a start date, an end date, a summary
A system row carries a position, a year, a title, a subtitle, a status, a contribution
A diagram row stores a structure, a text alternative, an owner, a status, an object key ...
A post row carries a slug, a series, a number, a title, a body, a status, an object key ...
A note row carries an intent, a state, a lane, a thread token, a creation timestamp
A note message row carries an author kind of sender or owner
A subscriber row carries a lowercased email, a state, a confirm token, an unsubscribe token ...
A page-view row is one row per route per day carrying a count, a deepest band
A booking row carries a start time, a state, a hold expiry
The first seeded published piece carries the pinned video-map headline ...
Seeding is idempotent across a restart
A fixed top bar spans the full width on every route ...
The rail is a vertical ruler of hairline ticks with a longer mark at each band boundary
The fixed contact control is labelled `LET'S TALK`
The footer credit reads `Designed by Studio Halvard`
Four drawn glyphs exist as geometry rather than as a font
Depth runs field, overlay gradients, content, diagram overlay, rail, top bar, curtain
A small share of field edges take thread hues chosen as connected paths ...
Every diagram is built from seven kinds of mark with no eighth
The index scrolls smoothly with several diagrams playing at once ...
The hero cue reads `scroll down` ...
The archive subtitle is the pinned frequency-log line ...
The reading column is offset left rather than centred
The contact panel is titled `Send a signal` ...
The studio index is a grid of cards, one per piece, one per diagram ...
The field, the diagrams are the only moving surfaces on the index
No image file, video file, font file ships with the build
There is one portfolio with no tenancy of any kind
No comment, like, reaction, follower graph, direct message exists ...
The stack band is authored content stating nothing about how the app is built
The archive renders its full seeded list without the page stalling
The app is reachable at the public address environment variable ...
A list endpoint returns a top-level JSON array ...
Exported still bytes live in the bucket rather than on the app's own disk
core asks covered by this grader
